chapterTitle: The Ripening-for-the-Sickle Strategy: Maneuver Them into Weakness
coreMove: Narrow the opponent's future options over time until their least bad move is the one that weakens them decisively.
reversal: Without real option-shaping, patience becomes drift; with impatience, the whole setup is wasted.
teachingEmphasis: reduce options, do not merely wait
make the collapse look self-generated because it was structured that way
